label: The three series-parent qualifiers are prose policy only: no metadata field or validator records the artifact identity or closing condition, so catch-all composition and artifact drift cannot be detected mechanically; graph-metadata records lineage (parent_id, children_ids), typed manual relationships and migration flags instead.

The only anti-catch-all signal is a child-count advisory that nothing consumes: assessPhaseParentHealth warns at >=20 children and errors at >=40 but its own contract says callers decide whether to fail or report, and a non-test grep found no production caller - a series parent with up to 19 unrelated children produces zero diagnostic.

Cross-track grouping is structurally suppressed for new children (they nest inside the parent) but the documented move-in recipe leaves no provenance trace: specFolder, specId, parentChain and parent_id are repointed with nothing recording the originating track, and migrated/migration_source exist only for legacy imports, so a cross-track move is a silent metadata edit.

Correction-vs-new-change has no mechanical anchor: manual.supersedes/related_to are shape-validated references only, nothing requires a correction to reopen or supersede the existing packet, and the create.sh lister plus Gate 3 wording that would steer it are advisory and post-hoc.

Existing parent-integrity flags guard linkage correctness, not grouping correctness: parent_id_review_required fires only when a re-derive would drop a non-null parent, and children_ids pruning fires only for children no longer on disk - neither judges whether a linked child belongs to the same artifact or whether a correction was misrouted as a new child.

A minimal warn-only guardrail package can sit on existing surfaces: record the series artifact and closing condition at creation (create.sh --phase already runs there), add a warn-only validator advisory comparing child docs/trigger phrases against the recorded artifact, surface assessPhaseParentHealth in validate output, and add a create-time same-artifact complete-sibling check that recommends Option A - every item recommends, none auto-selects.
